If the review request expected them in the response, that's a possible additional item (minor).
rca_of_the_issue: No regression detected. All refactors preserved behavior: the Blob-URL print flow avoids document.write (XSS surface removed and confirmed via blob: scheme + rendered content), the ComingSoon component reads REACT_APP_SITE_PASSWORD correctly, the Paxity _validate_payin helper enforces both 400 error paths, and the Stripe RATES_XOF barème (9000/19 USD, 9000/17 EUR) produces the expected persisted charged_amounts (19.0 / 17.0).
